review.disposition: Accept as shaped. Numbers migration follow-up completed; subsequent changes add documentation and workflow/artifact qualification, with no production-code change.

scope: Actual macOS arm64 native executable runs under .NET 8 and .NET 10; all 26 smoke contracts pass.
Template-free deterministic Pages mixed paragraph/table/table/paragraph and table-only creation, fixed dimensions, scalar types and dense-grid bounds.
Apple-edited Pages source retains numeric edit, both grids and inherited four-point layout through strict saved/reopened DOCX.

Region layout resolves sparsely; selected overrides and unresolved-property suppression remain independent. Numbers padding omissions require explicit partial result acceptance; complete PDF rejects those sources.
limits: NativeAOT execution does not establish composed PDF NativeAOT, other architectures/platforms, signed sandbox/provider acceptance, physical devices or published packages.
The separately linked composed PDF evidence covers managed complete-document routes and recorded font inputs.
Native Apple original PDF and edited DOCX support their stated profiles; localized display, emoji, paragraph/table gaps and receiving-application DOCX row-height appearance remain limited.
reproduction: Run the produced OfficeIMO.IWork.AotSmoke executable directly; all 26 PASS lines must be present.
